## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

**Date:** 2026-07-27  
**Link:** [AI Daily Brief — How to Get the Most from AI This Summer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kvmkj3dj_kw)  
**Summary:** The episode centers on moving from casual chatbot use to structured agent workflows: building richer context, creating small apps, running agentic loops, and experimenting with AI-supported microbusiness tasks.  
**How to use it now:** Pick one bounded workflow, provide the AI with context and success criteria, ask it to produce a first artifact, review the output, then loop with explicit corrections and next actions. Use current general-purpose AI tools or agent-capable coding/workflow environments.  
**Why it matters:** The actionable signal is not a new tool; it is an operating pattern: users who structure context, constraints, and iteration get more reliable output than users issuing isolated prompts.
